# ex: matchSelectorExpr value pattern matching pointer receiver (implicit & path)
ex {
	var t T
	t.X -> t.X + 1
}
-- x.go --
package m

type T struct{ X int }

func F(p *T) int {
	return p.X
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -3,5 +3,5 @@
 type T struct{ X int }

 func F(p *T) int {
-	return p.X
+	return p.X + 1
 }
